items.exampleEn: She shot the ball into the basket.
I want to lie on the beach all day.
Hard work is the key to success.
The sign indicates the way to the station.
items.exampleZh: 這個標示指出往車站的方向。

items.sentenceEn: Please have your tickets ready before you enter.
items.sentenceZh: 進場前請先準備好你的票。

items.audioEn: Our first plan failed, but the second one worked.
items.audioZh: 我們的第一個計畫失敗了，但第二個成功了。
options: They did not make a plan

items.sentenceEn: Don't lie on the grass. It's wet.
items.sentenceZh: 別躺在草地上，草是濕的。

items.sentenceEn: I'm happy to accept your offer.
items.sentenceZh: 我很樂意接受你的提議。

items.stemEn: You must have a ticket to ____ the museum.
items.stemZh: 你必須有票才能進入博物館。

items.stemEn: The new cafe was a great ____. It was full every day.
items.stemZh: 那家新咖啡店非常成功，每天都客滿。

items.passageEn: Kevin wanted to join the basketball team at his school. He prepared for weeks. On the big day, he shot the ball well, but he failed the running test. He felt so sad that he lay on his bed all evening. The next day, the coach called. "Your shooting indicates real talent," he said. "We have decided to accept you."
items.passageZh: Kevin 想加入學校的籃球隊，他準備了好幾個星期。到了測驗那天，他投籃投得很好，但跑步測驗沒通過。他難過得整個晚上都躺在床上。隔天，教練打電話來說：「你的投籃顯示出你真的有天分。我們決定接受你加入球隊。」

questions.questionZh: Kevin 哪一項測驗沒通過？

items.promptZh: 我們的活動辦得非常成功。
referenceEn: Our event was a big success.
Our event was a great success.
rubricZh: 「非常成功」可寫例如 was a big success、was a great success、was very successful
說已經辦完的活動用過去式（例如 was）

items.promptZh: 我哥哥正在準備明天的考試。
referenceEn: My brother is preparing for tomorrow's test.
My older brother is preparing for the test tomorrow.
rubricZh: 「正在準備」用現在進行式（例如 is preparing）
prepare for 表示「為…做準備」（例如 preparing for the test）
「考試」可寫，例如 test、exam 等；「哥哥」可寫，例如 brother、older brother 等
